relative_reference_source: Whole-run startup frame, 2026-10-16 16:16:39; before middle collection, NOT an exact middle motor-zero pose; subtraction only, no fit or encoder-zero constraint.
training_scope: All paired formal active_mode=xy points, including timeouts and all 2670 ring points; actual motor feedback inputs and measured absolute glove labels.

input_priority.policy: q0: side=1, bending=secondary; q123: bending=1, side=secondary. Soft preference, no guaranteed derivative ratio.

training.selection: Independent inner-validation early stopping per branch; outer-training refit. Final epochs are medians of the five pose-fold choices; all-data final refit.
training.pose_group_definition: floor(absolute_q / 2 degrees), same bin never crosses pose folds; adjacent bins may be close

limitations: Same-session window-mean validation only. No dynamic/contact/cross-session accuracy claim. No command targets or synthetic labels. No automatic encoder alignment or new physical zero calibration. Marginal input bounds do not establish joint coverage.
